text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the "Arima Kinen" has finally 
arrived. The dream of running in a GⅠ race 
together is about to come true.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, with Tokai Teio's sudden 
participation, the year-end grand finale 
was set to become the ultimate festival of 
excitement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her best friend and the one she admires. 
With an unbeatable lineup gathered, an 
unforgettable dream race begins!
